headingPath: 7.2 Fractional Units as Parts of a Whole

questions.stem: What is the term for a part of a whole basic unit divided into equal parts?
questions.solution: A part of a whole basic unit divided into equal parts is called a fractional unit because it represents one of the equal portions of the whole. The numerator is the number of parts taken, and the denominator is the total number of equal parts the whole is divided into. A mixed fraction is a combination of a whole number and a fraction, not a part of a whole unit.

hi.stem: एक पूर्ण इकाई के भाग के लिए क्या शब्द है जिसे समान भागों में विभाजित किया गया है?

questions.stem: What is the fraction that represents a length divided into two equal parts on a number line?
questions.solution: When a length is divided into two equal parts, each part is one-half of the whole. The fraction 1/2 correctly represents this division. The other options, such as 1/3 or 1/4, represent divisions into more than two parts, and 2/1 represents a whole number, not a part of a unit.

questions.stem: Which of the following represents a fraction that is greater than 1?
questions.solution: A fraction is greater than 1 when its numerator is larger than its denominator. 7/6 has a numerator (7) that is greater than its denominator (6), making it greater than 1. The other options have numerators that are equal to or smaller than their denominators, so they are not greater than 1.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of equivalent fractions?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 1/2, 2/4, 3/6. These fractions represent the same value when simplified. The other options do not have equivalent values because the numerator and denominator do not change proportionally.

headingPath: 7.2 Fractional Units as Parts of a Whole

questions.stem: Jaya walks a total of 5/6 km to reach her school. She takes an auto for 1/3 km. How much does she walk?
questions.solution: The total distance Jaya walks is 5/6 km. She takes an auto for 1/3 km. To find the distance she walks, subtract 1/3 from 5/6. 5/6 - 1/3 = 5/6 - 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2. So, she walks 1/2 km. The option 1/3 km is incorrect because it assumes the auto ride is the total distance. The option 1/6 km is incorrect because it subtracts 1/3 from 5/6 incorrectly. The option 2/3 km is incorrect because it adds 1/3 to 5/6 instead of subtracting.

hi.stem: जया अपने स्कूल जाने के लिए कुल 5/6 किमी चलती है। वह 1/3 किमी के लिए एक ऑटो लेती है। वह कितनी दूरी चलती है?
hi.solution: जया के द्वारा चली गई कुल दूरी 5/6 किमी है। वह 1/3 किमी के लिए एक ऑटो लेती है। चली गई दूरी ज्ञात करने के लिए 1/3 को 5/6 में से घटाएं। 5/6 - 1/3 = 5/6 - 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2। इसलिए, वह 1/2 किमी चलती है। विकल्प 1/3 किमी गलत है क्योंकि यह ऑटो यात्रा को कुल दूरी मान लेता है। विकल्प 1/6 किमी गलत है क्योंकि यह 5/6 में से 1/3 को गलत तरीके से घटाता है। विकल्प 2/3 किमी गलत है क्योंकि यह 1/3 को 5/6 में जोड़ देता है बजाय घटाने के।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi mathematical terminology.

mr.stem: जया शाळेत जाण्यासाठी एकूण 5/6 किमी चालते. ती 1/3 किमी साठी एक्स्ट्रा घेते. तिने किती चालावे लागते?
mr.solution: जयाचा एकूण अंतर 5/6 किमी आहे. ती 1/3 किमी साठी एक्स्ट्रा घेते. तिने चालावे लागणारे अंतर शोधण्यासाठी 1/3 चे 5/6 मधून बेरीज करावे लागेल. 5/6 - 1/3 = 5/6 - 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2. म्हणून, तिने 1/2 किमी चालावे लागते. 1/3 किमी ची पर्याय चुकीची आहे कारण ती एक्स्ट्रा चाल करण्याचे एकूण अंतर मानते. 1/6 किमी ची पर्याय चुकीची आहे कारण ती 5/6 मधून 1/3 चे बेरीज करते. 2/3 किमी ची पर्याय चुकीची आहे कारण ती 5/6 मध्ये 1/3 चे बेरीज करते बरोबर बेरीज करते.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology. The solution explanation is slightly awkward in Marathi but still conveys the correct reasoning.

questions.stem: The length of a blue line on a number line is represented by the fraction 3/4. Which of the following represents the same length?

questions.stem: If 2 cakes are divided equally among 5 children, what is the fraction of cake each child gets?
